diagrams.title: **Who decides the steps?** In workflow-driven code, you do, in advance, for every case
diagrams.caption: **Who decides the steps?** In workflow-driven code, you do, in advance, for every case. In model-driven code, the model decides at run time, using the tool descriptions you provide.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 400" aria-label="Workflow-driven code hard-codes a decision tree: is it about weather, call the weather API; is it about time, call the time API; otherwise give up. Model-driven code gives the agent a goal and a set of tools, and the model decides which tools to use." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-tool" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-tool" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>
      <text x="270" y="30" text-anchor="middle" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Workflow-driven: you script every branch</text>
      <rect x="210" y="46" width="120" height="40" rx="20" class="usr" style="fill:#E8EAF1;stroke:#4A5170;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="270" y="72" text-anchor="middle" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">question</text>
      <path d="M270 86 V104" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path>
      <path d="M270 108 L350 148 L270 188 L190 148 Z" class="bx2" style="fill:#F8F9FC;stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2"></path><text x="270" y="154" text-anchor="middle" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">weather?</text>
      <path d="M350 148 H386" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path><text x="364" y="138" text-anchor="middle" class="tx" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:14px">yes</text>
      <rect x="390" y="126" width="140" height="44" rx="10" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="460" y="154" text-anchor="middle" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">weather API</text>
      <path d="M270 188 V206" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path><text x="282" y="202" class="tx" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:14px">no</text>
      <path d="M270 210 L350 250 L270 290 L190 250 Z" class="bx2" style="fill:#F8F9FC;stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2"></path><text x="270" y="256" text-anchor="middle" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">time?</text>
      <path d="M350 250 H386" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path><text x="364" y="240" text-anchor="middle" class="tx" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:14px">yes</text>
      <rect x="390" y="228" width="140" height="44" rx="10" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="460" y="256" text-anchor="middle" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">time API</text>
      <path d="M270 290 V308" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path><text x="282" y="304" class="tx" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:14px">no</text>
      <rect x="200" y="312" width="140" height="44" rx="10" class="risk" style="fill:#FBE3E8;stroke:#C4344F;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="270" y="340" text-anchor="middle" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">give up</text>
      <text x="270" y="388" text-anchor="middle" class="lab ink-risk" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#8E1F35;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">every new case = more if/else code</text>
      <line x1="560" y1="16" x2="560" y2="384" stroke="#D7DCE8" stroke-width="2"></line>
      <text x="830" y="30" text-anchor="middle" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Model-driven (Strands): goal + tools</text>

      <rect x="600" y="294" width="150" height="46" rx="12" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="675" y="323" text-anchor="middle" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:15px">current_time</text>
      <rect x="760" y="294" width="140" height="46" rx="12" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="830" y="323" text-anchor="middle" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:15px">calculator</text>
      <rect x="910" y="294" width="140" height="46" rx="12" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="980" y="323" text-anchor="middle" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:15px">weather</text>
      <text x="830" y="388" text-anchor="middle" class="lab ink-tool" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#075A51;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">new ability = add a tool, not a branch</text>
    </svg>

diagrams.title: **The loop that makes it an agent
diagrams.caption: **The loop that makes it an agent.** The agent keeps going round: ask the model, run whatever tool it asks for, give the result back, ask again. It exits only when the model answers without asking for a tool.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 470" aria-label="The Strands agent loop. A prompt invokes the agent. Inside the loop, the agent invokes the model and gets back a response that is either text or a request to use a tool. If a tool is requested, the agent executes the tool and returns the result to the model. When the model is done, the agent returns the final response as the result." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-brain" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-brain" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-tool" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-tool" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>
      <rect x="330" y="20" width="750" height="430" rx="22" class="zone" style="fill:none;stroke:#D7DCE8;stroke-width:2;stroke-dasharray:8 6"></rect>
      <text x="705" y="50" text-anchor="middle" class="lab" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">Agentic loop: repeats until the model says it's done</text>
      <g data-step="invoke">
        <rect x="20" y="70" width="240" height="122" rx="16" class="usr" style="fill:#E8EAF1;stroke:#4A5170;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
        <text x="40" y="102" class="lab" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">Prompt</text>
        <text x="40" y="130" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">“Write a short story</text>
        <text x="40" y="152" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">about a robot who wants</text>
        <text x="40" y="174" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">to be a painter.”</text>
        <path d="M260 140 L356 172" class="ln flow" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path>
        <text x="300" y="134" text-anchor="middle" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">invoke</text>
      </g>
      <rect x="360" y="110" width="170" height="270" rx="18" class="agent" style="fill:#19203F;stroke:#19203F;stroke-width:2"></rect>
      <text x="445" y="250" text-anchor="middle" class="tl on-agent" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#F2F4F8;font-size:24px;font-weight:700">Agent</text>
      <g data-step="model">
        <path d="M532 150 Q660 74 796 104" class="ln-brain flow" marker-end="url(#ah-brain)" style="stroke:#B07600;stroke-width:3;fill:none"></path>
        <text x="650" y="84" text-anchor="middle" class="lab ink-brain" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#6E4A00;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">invoke model</text>
      </g>
      <g data-step="model-resp">
        <path d="M796 150 Q670 186 534 188" class="ln-brain flow" marker-end="url(#ah-brain)" style="stroke:#B07600;stroke-width:3;fill:none"></path>
        <text x="660" y="206" text-anchor="middle" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">response: text, or "use a tool"</text>
      </g>
      <g data-step="model model-resp">
        <rect x="800" y="74" width="260" height="104" rx="16" class="brain" style="fill:#FFF1CC;stroke:#B07600;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
        <text x="930" y="118" text-anchor="middle" class="tl" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:24px;font-weight:700">Model</text>
        <text x="930" y="150" text-anchor="middle" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">LLM on Amazon Bedrock</text>
      </g>
      <g data-step="tool">
        <path d="M534 296 Q670 272 796 316" class="ln-tool flow" marker-end="url(#ah-tool)" style="stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:3;fill:none"></path>
        <text x="664" y="270" text-anchor="middle" class="lab ink-tool" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#075A51;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">execute tool</text>
      </g>
      <g data-step="tool-resp">
        <path d="M796 372 Q670 392 534 342" class="ln-tool flow" marker-end="url(#ah-tool)" style="stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:3;fill:none"></path>
        <text x="664" y="410" text-anchor="middle" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">return result</text>
      </g>
      <g data-step="tool tool-resp">
        <rect x="800" y="290" width="260" height="110" rx="16" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
        <text x="930" y="334" text-anchor="middle" class="tl" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:24px;font-weight:700">Tools</text>
        <text x="930" y="366" text-anchor="middle" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">image API, search, …</text>
      </g>
      <g data-step="final">
        <path d="M358 330 H264" class="ln flow" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path>
        <text x="300" y="318" text-anchor="middle" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">final</text>
        <rect x="20" y="276" width="240" height="110" rx="16" class="usr" style="fill:#E8EAF1;stroke:#4A5170;stroke-width:3.5"></rect>
        <text x="140" y="324" text-anchor="middle" class="tl" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:24px;font-weight:700">Result</text>
        <text x="140" y="354" text-anchor="middle" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">back to the user</text>
      </g>
    </svg>
